name: classroom-prompt-builder
description: Classroom Prompt Builder - a free AI prompt builder for K-12 teachers with optional paid PDF guides. By Prompt Anatomy.

scripts.test: npm run test:docs && node tests/structure.test.js && npm run lint:js
scripts.test:mixed: npm run test && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:a11y
scripts.test:a11y: start-server-and-test "serve . -l 3000" http://127.0.0.1:3000/ "pa11y http://127.0.0.1:3000/ --config .pa11yrc.json && pa11y http://127.0.0.1:3000/privacy.html --config .pa11yrc.json && pa11y http://127.0.0.1:3000/terms.html --config .pa11yrc.json && pa11y http://127.0.0.1:3000/success?session_id=cs_test_A1b2C3d4E5f6G7h8I9j0KlMnOpQr --config .pa11yrc.json"
scripts.lint:html: npx html-validator-cli --file index.html && npx html-validator-cli --file privacy.html && npx html-validator-cli --file terms.html && npx html-validator-cli --file success.html
